implementation.name: T48
implementation.notes: license_id deliberately omitted because the repository contradicts itself. https://github.com/devsaurus/t48/blob/master/COPYING is the verbatim GPLv2 text (and GitHub reports GPL-2.0 on that basis), but every RTL file, e.g. https://github.com/devsaurus/t48/blob/master/rtl/vhdl/t48_core.vhd, carries Arnim Laeuger's three-condition BSD-style notice permitting "use in source and synthezised forms" -- which is neither GPL-2.0 nor a verbatim SPDX BSD-3-Clause. Resolving that conflict needs the author, not a guess. accuracy_id from the README: the core "aims for code-compatability and cycle-accuracy so that it can be used as a drop-in replacement for any MCS-48 controller". Chips linked from the testbench/variant set (8035/8039/8048 core plus the UPI-41A/42 variants); the catalogued i8041a and i8042ah correspond to the T8041A/T8042AH variants.
